name: Kaziranga

description.title: Kaziranga National Park – UNESCO World Heritage Site
description.short: World-famous for its one-horned rhinoceros and diverse wildlife in vast grasslands and wetlands.
description.long: Kaziranga National Park, a UNESCO World Heritage Site, is world-famous for its one-horned rhinoceros. Vast grasslands, wetlands, and forests create a haven for elephants, tigers, and migratory birds. Jeep safaris and elephant rides let travelers witness this wilderness up close, making Kaziranga Assam's pride and a must-visit for nature lovers.
description.history: Established in 1905, Kaziranga was declared a UNESCO World Heritage Site in 1985. It's home to two-thirds of the world's one-horned rhinoceros population.
description.overview: A pristine wilderness sanctuary where grasslands meet wetlands, offering incredible wildlife viewing opportunities.

safetyInformation: Follow park rules and stay in designated areas.
Maintain safe distance from wild animals.
Do not feed or disturb wildlife.
travelTips: Book safari permits in advance during peak season.
Carry binoculars and camera for wildlife photography.
Best time to visit is November to April.
